rows.title: A blank or eyes-off entry still prints in the PDF and preview: a gap, an empty grid cell, a bare Timeline dot, and a split 'Group roles by company' group
rows.summary: Now: every PDF renderer draws only the entries that print. It uses the same entryPrints rule as Word's `shown`, so a blank entry, or one whose fields are all hidden with their eyes, takes no item gap, grid cell, Timeline dot or role group, and the heading's keep is measured on the first entry that prints. The new helper printedEntries(section) in src/utils/entryPrints.js replaces `(section.items || []).filter(i => i.visible !== false)` in PdfSectionsOne/Two/Three.jsx, PdfTimelineSections.jsx, PdfSidebarColumn.jsx and PdfSidebarSections.jsx. Skills already filtered with skillGroupPrints and are unchanged. The PDF now agrees with Word, Markdown and the ATS text.
